title: Police Surprise Man At His Doorstep After He Runs From Them Twice
description:
On June 23rd, 2023, two officers on patrol noticed a vehicle that had fled a traffic stop earlier and tailed it. As soon as the vehicle stopped, the officers immediately got into action. The man persistently argued with the cops, attempting to convince them not to take his car. The man's vehicle was towed away, yet he remained adamant that he had done nothing wrong. He persistently argued that he wasn’t involved in the incident, and the dispute continued to escalate. The man was able to strike a deal with the cops, and in return, they were going to offer him an I-Bond. The man was charged with fleeing/eluding, resisting arrest and driving with a revoked license.
